'''The Master Plan... for Romance!''' (Japanese: '''恋のドッキドキ大作戦!!''', ''The Romantic Love Super Strategic Attack!!''), is the first bonus chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey volume 5|fifth volume]] of [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
{{MPJ|Pikachu}}, {{MPJ|Clefairy}}, and {{MPJ|Jigglypuff}} come across a muscleheaded {{MPJ|Machamp}} who's fallen for the beautiful {{MPJ|Vaporeon}}. Can anyone else say "Beauty and the Beast"?
